notes: Hand-labelled sentence templates for the DIRECTION_MISMATCH lint. sign is the sign of the bound change ('+' or '-'; several for sentences with several signed bindings). mismatch is the human label: does the wording contradict the sign? Includes cases the word-list heuristic is known to get wrong (direction words it does not know, negation after the verb, 'follow up'), so the false-positive and false-negative counts stay honest. Used by app.evals.direction and tests/test_evals.py.
